steps.message:
I added a checkbox to the `<main>` element in `index.html`:

```html
<label>
  <input type="checkbox" name="done">
  Mark as done
</label>
```

It's the browser's built-in checkbox, so clicking it switches between checked and unchecked without any JavaScript. Because the text is wrapped in the `<label>`, clicking "Mark as done" toggles the box too, and screen readers announce the checkbox with that text.

Two things it doesn't do yet:
- **The state isn't saved.** Reloading the page clears it. Saving it would take a small amount of JavaScript, such as storing it in `localStorage`.
- **There's only one checkbox.** The page doesn't have a task list yet, so it isn't attached to any item. When you add tasks, put one of these next to each and change the text to the task's name.

I haven't committed the change.
